surround_tests.startup_retry: First launch failed before tests: no writable Zen/default DDC node. R2 used the existing project test DDC graph; failed startup log retained.

scope.build: Current frozen Development Editor executables, not Shipping
scope.load: 160 AI, dedicated server + 2 clients; Client1 DX12 1600x900, Client2 NullRHI
scope.hit_strategy: Six native query-only UBoxComponent hit proxies per enemy; Simple strategy
scope.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU, chosen D3D12 adapter 0
scope.limits: Timing scopes identify engine work/wait sites, not OS Ready-vs-Blocked or hardware cache misses. Native unit counters are pipeline-delayed. No causal A/B or Shipping performance claim.

slot_audit.model: Stable spatial slot array + reverse ownership map + deduplicated FIFO admissions. Spatial ring is not a circular buffer.
slot_audit.spatial_waiting_limit: Not the 8-person attack queue; may contain all registered non-inner participants. Production test explicitly exercises 152 spatial candidates at 160 participants.
slot_audit.recovery: Actual MoveTo failure releases the owned assignment and appends a new FIFO request with 1s retry delay; no-progress watchdog is 8s. Stale assignment revisions cannot revoke a newer grant.

confirmed_gaps.finding: Outer Kind0 navigation-projected positions skip the full-capsule environment occupancy test. NavMesh projection alone does not establish standability.
Failed ownership is requeued with a participant-wide delay, but the failed slot or enemy-slot pair is not excluded. A persistent bad candidate can be granted again.
Approach-point spacing is validated for inner Kind1, not outer Kind0. Different outer slots can project to overlapping locations.

slot_audit.minimal_followup: Apply environmental capsule clearance and spacing to consumed outer goals; distinguish globally invalid geometry from per-enemy route failure and temporary crowd blockage. Preserve stable SlotId and use another valid candidate/short cooldown, not ring-array deletion or a second manager.
slot_audit.observed_timeouts: Two manager counters 2->14 and 1->12: 23 additional no-progress requeues during this capture. Recovery was observed; blocked-corner gameplay quality was not validated.
slot_audit.changes_made_this_turn: Diagnostics and existing tests only; no gameplay/source refactor.

public_provenance.interpretation: Public extract; numeric timing values unchanged. Source-only checkout did not run the trace. Local absolute filenames, if present, are replaced.
